versions.changelog:
Initial release of jf-open-pro-device-image-flip.

- Supports horizontal (mirror) and vertical (flip) image orientation adjustments for JFTech devices.
- Allows querying and setting of current flip/mirror status.
- Includes environment variable configuration for device binding and API access.
- Provides command-line usage examples for querying, setting, and resetting image flip/mirror states.
- Handles corridor mode, which swaps mirror/flip effects.
- Requires device to be online and bound to an account.
